purpose: Recompose the mapped Sherpa-and-Beanie look into a powerful wide Signature campaign while preserving the protected customer/product and exact cleaned font sculpture.

fashion_theme_team.next_authority: prompt assertion review, approved provider runtime, then independent visual-commerce-qa

composition.customer_priority: One confident protagonist at campaign scale; no passive portrait showroom treatment.
composition.environment: Rain-cleared SF/Oakland industrial roof deck: damp concrete, weathered steel, distant cranes and bridge lights dissolving into fog.
composition.brand_object: Exact single-line SkyyRose gold-and-copper font sculpture with rose, physically supported and intentionally placed.

creative_direction.story_role: A self-possessed West Coast customer arrives after rain; the Sherpa and beanie lead while the SkyyRose sculpture reads as a permanent civic sign, not decoration.
focal_hierarchy: exact SG-009 Sherpa and SG-007 beanie
creative_direction.logo_off_recognition: West Coast industrial refinement, a black-and-white Sherpa silhouette, rose-gold civic lettering, and fog-lit Bay depth identify Signature without relying on logos.
anti_generic: no glossy hotel lobby or luxury apartment
no wall-mounted wordmark or undersized sculpture
no pasted customer, hard halo, or unrelated props

source_bindings.preserve: identity, pose, SG-009 jacket, SG-007 beanie
black outer, white sherpa body lining, red rose front mark
exact beanie silhouette and small slightly off-center patch
material and architectural language only; output must be wide
single-line SkyyRose letterforms, gold palette, copper rose, exact proportions

higgsfield.resolution_note: The installed CLI does not expose a resolution flag; verify returned dimensions before Comfy staging.
higgsfield.prompt: Cinematic urban-grit Signature campaign on a rain-cleared SF/Oakland industrial roof deck. The exact SG-009 Sherpa Jacket and SG-007 Signature Beanie customer owns the left third at full-body product-readable scale. The exact clean transparent SkyyRose font sculpture stands on the right as a freestanding rose-gold and copper civic sign with real weight, base contact, occlusion, shadow, and damp-floor reflection. Board-formed concrete, weathered black steel, distant cranes and bridge lights, marine fog, warm edge light, neutral skin, deep open blacks, restrained film grain. Professional 16:9 hierarchy; no lobby, apartment, wall plaque, skyline wallpaper, pasted halo, split wordmark, or missing copper rose.
higgsfield.brand_context: SkyyRose Signature is refined West Coast industrial luxury: rose-gold craft against damp concrete and marine fog, confident customer presence, cinematic restraint, and exact product authority.
higgsfield.product_context: Preserve SG-009 black outer construction, white sherpa body lining, red front rose, and the protected SG-007 beanie. Preserve the font sculpture as one exact SkyyRose wordmark with its copper rose; never split the wordmark, omit the rose, or turn it into a wall sticker.

provider_capability.rule: A provider result is only an environment and integration candidate; protected product and sculpture pixels remain authoritative.

allowed_operations: contact shadow and restrained reflection integration
mask-bounded product correction from approved authority
forbidden_operations: rejected candidate as a new generation input

observe: load the three founder-rejected SIG-1 results as negative evidence only
orient: Higgsfield creates one native wide campaign candidate
portrait environment is material authority, not final composition
decide: hard-fail product drift, tiny protagonist, split lettering, missing rose, wall sticker, or portrait output

execute_blockers: corrected enhanced prompt has not passed product and sculpture assertions
candidate-bound preflight and paid Higgsfield generation approval not recorded
